surface_verification.justification: No user-facing surface exists in this diff: two CI workflow steps, one out-of-band operator CLI, tests and docs. This repo ships no web or CLI product surface an E2E run could drive. The equivalent production-time proof was run instead: both newly-wired gates executed green locally before being made blocking, the security gate body was executed over three fixture shapes outside Actions, and the drift producer was run against the live repository.

behaviors.behavior: Both surface verifiers run in ci.yml required job
Neither surface gate is loosened by continue-on-error or pipe-pipe-true
A gate step naming a missing script fails
A new scripts/verify_*_surface.py wired to nothing fails the build
behaviors.evidence: test_checks_that_gate.py::test_every_surface_verifier_is_wired_to_some_workflow PASSED; probed with a real orphan file -> RED

behaviors.behavior: Only executable run: lines count as wiring; a comment mention does not
The CI-gate guard classifies (gate)-suffixed steps as gates
behaviors.evidence: test_checks_that_gate.py::test_the_gate_guard_can_see_the_surface_gates PASSED; probed by removing the keyword -> guard exited 0 on a loosened gate

behaviors.behavior: The security gate prints a labelled verdict, not a bare count
Every severity is counted across findings.json AND prompt_risks.json
behaviors.evidence: test_security_gate_verdict.py::test_every_severity_is_counted_across_both_scan_outputs PASSED; behavioral probe of the extracted step body over 3 fixtures

behaviors.behavior: The severity breakdown reaches the job summary
Reporting can never fail the gate when GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY is unset
behaviors.evidence: test_security_gate_verdict.py::test_reporting_cannot_fail_the_gate PASSED; shipwright-compliance A5.8 behavioral probe 19 passed

behaviors.behavior: A PASS with open high findings is annotated
The security gate still blocks on critical only
Drift is reported in both directions; advisory contexts suppress
Blank and whitespace-only names create no drift
The dedup key is stable and divergence-specific
Enumeration covers every workflow, not the five adopt scaffolds
A workflow that cannot run on a pull request is not derived
One unparseable workflow does not sink enumeration
An empty derived set never reads as in-sync
gh missing or hanging is a controlled error, not a traceback
The HTTP status is recovered so 404 is distinguished from 403
A repo that requires nothing reads as an empty set, not as unreadable
Contexts come from rulesets and classic protection, unioned
Neither source readable raises; one readable source is enough
The policy is read for the named branch, not always main
An unreachable repo exits 2 before any policy lookup
In-sync exits 0 filing nothing; drift files exactly one item keyed repo-at-branch
The posted-status registry rejects a key no consumer visits
The live GitHub ruleset read returns the real must-pass set for this repo
behaviors.reason: the real GitHub API cannot be a hermetic test; exercised live at every stage instead, and every decision taken on its response is covered by the mocked host-IO rows above

behaviors.behavior: A non-GitHub or malformed origin remote is refused, not guessed at
The sweep verifier does not hand its own $CI flag to its subject
behaviors.evidence: test_checks_that_gate.py::test_the_sweep_verifier_does_not_hand_its_own_ci_flag_to_its_subject PASSED; mutation-probed (dropping env= turns it RED). Both gates re-run under CI=true: verify_sweep_delivery_surface 8/8, verify_contract_surface PASS.

ci_supplychain_ack.statement: Adds two run: steps invoking in-repo scripts to ci.yml and edits one run: body in security.yml. No action, permission, secret, trigger or external dependency changes, so the pinning posture is untouched: GitHub-owned actions stay on mutable tags, third-party stay SHA-pinned. The trust boundary only tightens - two verifiers that ran nowhere now block, and the security gate reports the severities it does not block on instead of implying it found none.
